text:
alex_ae: Heads-up — FinServ (AML bank) inbound for a POC. Core asks: 10-year audit log retention, HSM-backed KMS (BYOK), plus HIPAA/SOC2 evidence. Need line-item pricing, lead times, and what we can include in a 12‑month committed offer.

maria_se: Got it. I'll assemble numbers and a deployment timeline. @josh_finance can you confirm discount thresholds for 12mo commits? Also want to confirm any special handling for 10yr retention vs our standard tiers. :eyes:

josh_finance: Quick notes — standard 12mo reserved commit gives ~15% off usage; for >$250k ARR we can move to ~25% with approval. Audit-log retention is an additive charge: typical public pricing is $0.12/GB/mo year1, stepping down to $0.03/GB/mo long tail. For a 10yr locked retention we quote lifecycle/tiered pricing and a minimum archival handling fee. HSM add-on options: managed HSM pool (dedicated) = +$10k/mo or KMS API-based with HSM attestation = ~$0.02/GB in heavy-call scenarios. Any deeper concession (>20% total) needs deal-desk sign-off.

tara_legal: We can provide SOC2 Type II report and a HIPAA BAA. FinServ specifically requested key rotation logs and artifact delivery for audits — that is doable but we should mark around a professional services fee for evidence ingestion/packaging if they want custom reports. I'll prepare the minimal contract language and a checklist of deliverables.

sam_security: Operational caveats: HSM-backed BYOK integration window ~3-4 weeks for validation and attestation. 10yr retention => recommend cold-tier exports + WORM policies; we will need to define export/restore SLAs. For public/private deployments, encryption at rest with quarterly key rotation is standard; if they want annual rotation reporting/attestations, that adds ops time.

alex_ae: Do we have a concise quote snippet I can send to the customer now (with caveat 'subject to deal-desk approval')? They asked for line items so they can present to procurement. :+1:

maria_se: Pasting a starter quote (example numbers, will refine):

```
Base Dedicated (3x A10 equiv): $18,000/mo
12mo Commit (15%): -$2,700 => $15,300/mo
Audit-log retention (10yr) — lifecycle estimate:
  Year 1: $0.12/GB/mo
  Year 2-3: $0.06/GB/mo
  Year 4-10: $0.03/GB/mo
HSM add-on (managed HSM pool): $10,000/mo
Compliance evidence bundle (SOC2 report + HIPAA BAA + artifact packaging): $5,000/mo (or one-time PS fee)
Estimated example (5TB first-year active archive): + ~5TB * $0.12 = $614/mo (year1 archive)
Notes: final pricing subject to commit level; concessions >20% need deal-desk approval.
```

josh_finance: If they commit $500k ACV we can flatten audit pricing to $0.035/GB/mo and HSM to $6k/mo. Also we can trade a modest professional services credit for a 2yr commit. I'll flag if we can go to 25% off on infra.

alex_ae: Perfect. I'll send an initial email with that table + \"subject to deal-desk approval\" and request a technical deep-dive Tues 11am. @maria_se can you lead the tech call?

maria_se: Yep — I'll prepare a short runbook and a slide for integration points (BYOK flows, retention lifecycle, export path). Will include expected timeline: private deployment provisioning 6-8 weeks, HSM validation 3-4 weeks (can overlap).

tara_legal: I'll drop the BAA draft and SOC2 artifact checklist in this thread by EOD. Will call out any redlines we should watch for (data residency, log export access).

sam_security: Also adding: we should document the acceptance criteria for the POC around log integrity (hashing + signed manifests) so auditors can validate. I'll post a short checklist after the runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created INFRA-4521 for FinServ private provision (assigned eng-infra). ETA ~6 weeks.

alex_ae: Great work. I will include the \"subject to deal-desk approval\" language and tag @deal-desk when I post the formal quote. Will follow up with next steps after the tech call. :partyparrot:
